mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit FROM scm_delivery_package_item i JOIN scm_delivery_package p ON p.id = i.package_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE p.delivery_id = #{deliveryId} ORDER BY p.seq, i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_delivery_package_item (package_id, delivery_item_id, material_id, qty) VALUES (#{packageId}, #{i.deliveryItemId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.qty})
